tagline: A leading global gold mining company focused on operational excellence and cost optimization
hero_kpi_rationale: Gold production is the key KPI reflecting AngloGold Ashanti's operational capacity and growth of its mining portfolio. With a 3% increase in 2025 and positive momentum from acquisitions (Augusta Gold and Coeur Sterling), this KPI demonstrates the company's inorganic growth strategy and optimization of existing assets.

kpis.name: Gold Production
kpis.explanation: Total quantity of gold mined in a year, measured in millions of troy ounces.
kpis.description: 2025 production is driven by improved operational performance, particularly at Tropicana in Australia and Geita in Tanzania, reinforcing AngloGold Ashanti's position as a significant global producer.
kpis.signal: Production growth driven by acquisitions of Augusta Gold and Coeur Sterling, as well as operational improvements in Australia and Tanzania.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: The portion of revenue remaining after deducting direct costs of ore extraction and processing.
kpis.description: Gross margin improves in 2025, supported by effective mine cost management and stable production, despite gold price volatility.
kpis.signal: Improving gross margin due to operational cost optimization and economies of scale.

kpis.name: Op Margin
kpis.explanation: Operating profit before interest and taxes relative to total revenue.
kpis.description: Operating margin increases due to discipline in general and administrative expenses, reflecting operational efficiency post-acquisitions.
kpis.signal: Improved operational profitability despite gold price volatility.

kpis.name: R&D Intensity
kpis.explanation: Research and development expenditures relative to total revenue.
kpis.description: R&D investments remain marginal and focused on energy efficiency, decarbonization, and mining safety improvements.
kpis.signal: Low R&D intensity, typical of the traditional mining sector focused on operational efficiency.

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures
kpis.explanation: Spending on equipment, infrastructure, and mining projects to sustain and expand operations.
kpis.description: 2025 capex is directed toward extending mine life, improving energy efficiency, and integrating newly acquired assets.
kpis.signal: Higher capex to sustain production and modernize mining assets toward decarbonization.

kpis.name: Headcount
kpis.explanation: Total number of people directly employed by AngloGold Ashanti worldwide.
kpis.description: The company maintains discipline on staffing while investing in training and development of critical talent for modern mining operations.
kpis.signal: Slight decline in headcount, indicating ongoing operational optimization and gradual automation.

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of €15.08 billion in the latest year

kpis.name: Total Debt
kpis.description: Total debt extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Total debt of €2.28 billion in the latest year

risks.title: Increased competition on production costs
risks.score_rationale: The risk is mentioned in Item 3D, with strong language on competitive pressure related to costs. The trend is stable, but the 'Competition' category significantly impacts operational competitiveness.

risks.title: Dependence on key partners in joint ventures
risks.score_rationale: Central position in the 10-K, strong language on operational risks due to lack of control. Trend is stable, high weight in the group's industrial structure.

risks.title: Mining regulation in South Africa
risks.score_rationale: Top-ranked risk, highly alarming language on legal obligations. Trend is rising, major weight in South Africa, the historical core of operations.

risks.title: Cybersecurity of mining operations
risks.score_rationale: New risk explicitly mentioned in Item 16K, preventive but concerned language. Trend is rising, reflecting a growing threat to critical infrastructure.

risks.title: Environmental rehabilitation post-mining
risks.score_rationale: High-ranking risk, strong language on future costs. Trend is stable, but high weight due to increasing regulatory obligations.

risks.title: Availability and cost of water
risks.score_rationale: Key operational risk mentioned under physical constraints, concrete language on shortages. Trend is rising, especially in arid regions such as South America.

risks.title: Tense relations with local communities
risks.score_rationale: Repeatedly mentioned in social risks, cautious but concerned language. Trend is stable, but high impact on operating permits.

risks.title: Mining safety and industrial accidents
risks.score_rationale: Major risk highlighted in Item 16H (mine safety), strong language on human and regulatory consequences. Trend is stable, critical weight in the sector.

ai_positioning.summary: AngloGold Ashanti does not mention any strategy or initiative related to artificial intelligence in its recent reports. The focus remains on operational efficiency, safety, decarbonization, and mining cost optimization, with no reference to AI as a strategic technological lever.
evidence: No mention of AI or machine learning in the 2025 10-K
No references to predictive analytics or advanced automation beyond standard operations
Cited technological innovations mainly concern water management, mine waste, and energy efficiency
